title: DO NOT QUIT | Trust God And Never Give Up (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: let us not become weary in doing good for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up this is what the Bible reminds us in Galatians 6 verse 9. another translation says and let us not be wary and well-doing for in due season we shall reap if we faint not both of these translations impart the same Divine wisdom we should persevere in the face of difficulties knowing that there will be a reward for our faithfulness

so I am here to encourage you today to trust God and never give up do not quit with God at our side we can confront the harshest of circumstances head on I am also going to pray a powerful prayer with you in the mighty name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer have you ever found yourself on the edge of giving up overwhelmed by the burdens you carry or have you

ever asked yourself is this struggle even worth it if you've said yes to either of these questions you're not alone we all face challenges financial difficulties emotional heartbreak health issues the Deep pain of loss and the list goes on in those moments the instinct to quit to throw in the towel seems almost unavoidable but remember trust God and never give up God's promise isn't that we will never get tired it's that we will reap a harvest if we keep pushing forward

let us explore some important things to keep in mind that will encourage you not to give up even when the going gets tough first important point is to know that the promised land is just beyond the obstacle what I'm saying here is that often the biggest breakthroughs the answers to our prayers and the promised land of blessings we've been waiting for are just on the other side of the obstacles we face so when we feel like giving up we may actually

be closer to our Miracle than we think let's look at the story of the Israelites they wandered in the desert for 40 years right on the doorstep of the Promised Land can you imagine if they'd given up right before reaching their destination in the Book of Joshua chapter 1 verse 3. God tells Joshua every place that the soul of your foot will tread upon I have given you as I said to Moses just like them you might be closer to your

breakthrough than you think so do not give up for the dawn is often darkest just before the light breaks through it's often when we're closest to our goals that we consider giving up these trials and tribulations you're facing they're not there to stop you they're there to prepare you my friends the promised land isn't just a place of milk and honey it represents new beginnings and blessings that come after hardships yes the desert journey is long and taxing but what awaits

you is far greater than anything you can imagine you've come too far to give up now perhaps you've been working hard for years and still haven't seen the fruits of your labor but that doesn't mean you won't when you feel like quitting remember the Israelites they were slaves they wandered in the wilderness but they eventually made it to the promised land your Promised Land your breakthrough your moment it's there just beyond the obstacle you're facing let's not forget that it was

God who led the Israelites to their promised future you don't have to bear your burdens alone trust God when the path gets tough remember the Israelites had God guiding them through the wilderness you too have God to guide you through your struggles so what do we learn your difficulties aren't a sign that you should quit they're the last leg of your journey the final push that you need to enter into the new life that's been prepared for you so trust God

and keep moving you can't give up now do not quit another crucial point is to acknowledge that the trial is not the end it's the process consider the story of Job here's a man who had everything and lost it all yet even in the depths of his suffering he never cursed God in Job 1 verse 22 the Bible tells us and all this job did not sin nor charge god with wrong imagine the magnitude of his trials but guess what his

suffering was not the end of his story it was a part of his journey the hardships you face aren't meant to break you they're meant to shape you just like metal is purified Through Fire your character is strengthened through trials think of a blacksmith they heat the metal until it's red hot and then hammer it into shape the process might seem harsh but it's necessary to create something strong and resilient this aligns perfectly with the words of the Apostle Paul in

Romans 5 verses 3 to 4 which says and not only that but we also glory in tribulations knowing that tribulation produces perseverance and perseverance character and character hope these trials are not meant to defeat you are designed to build you up and prepare you for greater things but let's be honest here no one wants to go through what job went through but his story teaches us an invaluable lesson that even when we don't understand the reason for our pain we need

to trust that there's a purpose behind it it's part of the process that makes us who we are job experienced blessings beyond measure he got double for his trouble a two-fold increase in his fortunes precisely because he remains steadfast and refused to give up even in the face of unimaginable suffering he stayed the course even everything around him was falling apart in life you'll encounter hardships that will make you question everything you might find yourself wrestling with thoughts like why is

this happening to me or what did I do to deserve this perhaps you'll even wonder is there a purpose to this suffering or will things ever get better it's natural to feel this way but let me tell you the pity party is over stop feeling sorry for yourself cancel the reservations for self-pity you don't need them instead lean into the strength that comes from God now is not the time to quit it's the time to dig deeper and persevere but hold

on and trust God through the process just like job your current trials are not the end of your story they're just a chapter maybe even a sentence in the grand scheme of things so when you're going through a difficult time think of it as a refining process imagine yourself as a piece of metal becoming stronger and more resilient with each blow the moments that challenge us the most are often the ones that Forge our character refine our faith and prepare us

for our god-given destiny job did not give up and neither should you his story teaches us to stand firm and trust God through the trials as rough as they may be Isaiah 40 verse 31. reminds us but those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength they shall Mount up with wings like eagles they shall run and not be wary they shall walk and not faint the next important point to consider is that you need to trust God's timing not

your own Sarah and Abraham waited decades for the promise of a child Joseph spent years in prison before rising to power Moses led the Israelites for 40 years before they reached the promised land what do they all have in common they had to learn to trust God's timing Ecclesiastes 3 verse 1 tells us to everything there is a season a time for every purpose under heaven so often we rush we want things to happen now but impatience can lead us to

make rash decisions sometimes those decisions can take us away from the path God has laid out for us think of Saul who became impatient waiting for Samuel and took matters into his own hands that one act of impatience cost him his kingdom in first Samuel 13 verses 13 to 14. Samuel tells Saul you have done foolishly you have not kept the Commandment of the Lord your God which he commanded you for now the Lord would have established your kingdom over Israel

forever but now your kingdom shall not continue Samuel's warning to Saul acts as a stuck lesson for each of us about the heavy toll of impatience and Disobedience as I often tell my children Disobedience comes with a price tag consider Saul his kingdom wasn't just disrupted it was permanently Stripped Away From Him and I don't want you to miss this he also lost the precious favor of God that had once graced his life so this story is a compelling reminder that

our sense of timing often does not align with God's perfect timing and our lapses in judgment or moments of impatience can result in losing God's favor therefore we need to exercise patience uphold obedience and remain in alignment with God's Divine timing foregoing these principles not only risks our blessings but also jeopardizes the special favor and guidance that God bestows upon us let's not make the same mistakes that Saul did let's honor God's timing and commands in doing so we truly prosper

and we are also able to maintain a relationship of favor with the Lord don't rush the process understand that God's timing is always perfect even when it doesn't align with our own plans maybe you're praying for a job a life partner or a breakthrough in your health you've done everything you can and you're just waiting for something to happen we all have to wait for God's perfect timing just like Sarah Abraham Joseph Moses and many others when you feel impatient go

back to the Bible or watch this video again read about The Heroes of Faith who had to wait on the Lord see how their stories turned out there in the Bible for a reason to remind us to trust God's timing even when it's hard so the next time you find yourself staring at the clock wondering when God Will Make a Move remember this his timing is perfect your waiting season is not a wasted season it's a season of growth a season

of preparation for what's to come trust God's timing and don't take shortcuts that might take you off his path for you another important point is to remember that God's grace is sufficient the Apostle Paul had a thorn in the flesh a constant suffering that he had to endure he pleaded with God to remove it and what was God's answer we see his reply in second Corinthians 12 9. which says my grace is sufficient for you for my strength is made perfect

in weakness this verse is a strong reminder that even in our darkest hours God's grace is enough you don't have to be perfect you don't have to have it all together God's grace is more than enough to sustain you when you feel like giving up his strength is made perfect in our weakness when we're weak that's when he's strong the Bible Echoes this sentiment in Joel 3 verse 10 saying let the weak say I'm strong this verse serves as a potent

reminder that our strength comes from a power greater than ourselves and in acknowledging our weaknesses we open the door for God's strength to manifest in our lives so maybe you're facing something that seems impossible to overcome right now you're tired your drain and you feel like you can't go on but you don't have to go through it alone let God's grace fill you Empower you and sustain you even Paul a great man of Faith had his moments of weakness but he

didn't quit he relied on God's grace if you think about it God's grace is an Incredible Gift we don't earn it we can't it's just given freely to us and that's something to hold on to especially when times are tough you don't have to go through your trials alone you have God's grace to uphold you so when you feel like quitting when you feel like you can't take another step remember these words God's grace is sufficient you have everything you need

to overcome your trials don't quit trust in God's sufficient Grace and allow his strength to be made perfect in your weakness and you know what else is another interesting point your testimony can be someone else's Survival Guide when we Face difficulties it's easy to focus solely on our struggles but did you ever think that your trials could be someone else's Survival Guide just like in the biblical account of the Samaritan woman at the well who went back to her town and

shared her testimony leading many to believe in Jesus in John 4 verse 39. the Bible tells us and many of the Samaritans of that City believed in him because of the word of the woman who testified he told me all that I ever did your story can Inspire others show them the way and give them hope and this is a part of our Divine Purpose God wants us to be catalysts for Change and beacons of light in the lives of those

around us by sharing your struggles and how you've overcome them you can Inspire resilience and Faith encouraging others to never give up but to trust in God's plan some time ago I faced a harrowing experience that tested my faith I had gone into a store briefly only to return and find my car broken into my laptop bag which contained my bank cards and important documents was stolen initially I was overwhelmed with fear and thoughts of giving up on ever recovering my

belongings but in that critical moment I turned to God asking him to step into the situation and help me reclaim what was taken from me with that prayer in my heart I filed a police report and returned home holding on to the hope that I'd get my stuff back amazingly a colleague soon called me to say my bag was at the police station someone had turned it in to this day I can't explain how my stolen belongings found their way back

to me fully intact but to God be all the glory god answered my prayer that's the God we serve greater than any obstacle or problem we might encounter so put your trust in him and never give up our God is faithful if he has done it for me and countless others he will do it for you so when you choose to persevere you're not just making a decision for yourself you're making a decision for everyone who watches you everyone who knows

that you're going through a rough time your decision to keep going might be the Catalyst that helps someone else keep going to in my ordeal with the stolen belongings my experience became a powerful testimony to my colleagues the police officers and everyone else who knew about the situation they all understood how unlikely it was for me to recover those items yet through my experience they got to witness firsthand the faithfulness of God had I simply thrown in the towel and given

up I would have missed out on witnessing God's remarkable faithfulness in my life your journey however difficult it might be has the potential to be a beacon of light for others in their moments of Darkness your testimony your story can be their Survival Guide the strength you display in overcoming your hardships can be the Boost that someone else needs to overcome theirs look around you people are struggling just like you they're going through difficulties facing challenges feeling the urge to quit

what if your story can give them hope what if your story can Inspire them to keep fighting another day so don't quit not just for your sake but for the sake of those around you by persevering you're not just securing your breakthrough you're also potentially securing theirs trust God hold on to your faith and never give up your story is too important your testimony too valuable I challenge you to stand firm in whatever you're facing today you're not alone God is

with you and we're here to support each other and that's why we post these daily devotionals and pray daily for those who are a part of our daily Jesus devotional Community it's not because it's easy in fact it's not easy at all but we believe that we were called to do this we rely on God's strength because we're here for you we're committed to this mission for Christ and God has a greater purpose in all this to touch millions of lives

so let's commit to enduring our individual trials and doing so as a United and strong faith-filled Community the message is clear do not quit trust God and never give up with God by your side you're not a quitter you're a winner now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to

our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father the creator of all that is seen and unseen Your Glory fills the heavens and your grace fills our hearts father I come before you humbly asking for forgiveness for the times I've done wrong and for the moments when my faith wavered Lord I stand before you now committing that I will not quit I will not give up I am grateful that the blessings you have in store for me far surpassed the challenges that stand

in my way Lord I thank you that my trials are not the end they are the process that makes me stronger father I ask that you give me the patience to trust your timing and not my own Lord Lead Me Away From The Temptations of taking shortcuts and making compromises that could steer me away from your Divine path for my life in the name of Jesus I rebuke the spirit of impatience and anxiety so that I may walk in God's perfect

timing and peace Lord your grace is sufficient for me I lean on your strength not mine Lord I am confident that you will deliver me as you have delivered those before me in the name of Jesus I break every bond that holds me back and Every curse placed against Me O my loved ones Lord I ask for your healing touch over my body mine and spirit I Thank You Lord For Your Divine protection Abundant Blessings and mercies father I ask that

you cover my loved ones with your love and grace may you give us the courage to keep going and never give up Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I thank you for all the hearts that are opening to you right now we come in agreement to take that next step in faith even when we can't see the whole picture in the name of Jesus we rebuke every force that aims to divide us discourage us or push us

into despair we declare that we will not quit but instead we put our complete trust in God's unfailing love and wisdom to guide us through every Challenge and obstacle thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us

to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can

present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of

prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray the God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all
